class.name: UZULook
class.brief_description: Ready-made 3D look presets (sky, light, atmosphere, color grade, materials, camera lenses) for scripts and agents.

method.name: add_lamp
method.description: Adds a warm lamp at [param position] under [param root]: an [OmniLight3D] with a steep falloff, so only what it reaches is bright, and a small glowing bulb. New nodes are owned by [param root]. Returns [code]{"lamp": path}[/code].

method.name: add_lighting_rig
method.description: Adds a fill light (from the side, in the color of the sky) and a rim light (from behind) under [param root], for three-point lighting with the sun as the key light. Neither casts shadows nor affects the sky. Returns the paths as [code]{"fill_light": path, "rim_light": path}[/code].

method.name: apply_to_scene
method.description: Applies the look to the scene rooted at [param root]: adds a [WorldEnvironment] (or updates the existing one) with [method create_environment] (with clouds if [param clouds] is [code]true[/code]), [method create_camera_attributes] and a [Compositor] with [UZUPostEffect] (edge contrast and vignette; not at [constant QUALITY_LOW]), and configures the sun (the first [DirectionalLight3D] that drives the sky) with [method configure_sun], adding one if there is none. New nodes are owned by [param root], so they are saved with the scene. Returns what was done, for example [code]{"world_environment": "added", "sun": "configured"}[/code].

method.name: configure_camera
method.description: Sets the field of view of [param camera] to [param lens]. A non-zero [param shift] (a fraction of the view height, positive is up) moves the framing up or down without tilting the camera, so vertical lines stay parallel.

method.name: configure_fill_light
method.description: Configures [param light] as a weak fill light from the side, in the color of the sky, without shadows and without affecting the sky.

method.name: configure_lamp
method.description: Configures [param lamp] as a warm lamp whose light falls off quickly. Shadows are enabled except at [constant QUALITY_LOW].

method.name: configure_rim_light
method.description: Configures [param light] as a rim light from behind, opposite the sun, without shadows and without affecting the sky.

method.name: configure_sun
method.description: Configures [param sun] for [param atmosphere]: direction, color and energy, and split soft shadows that follow [param quality].

method.name: create_camera_attributes
method.description: Returns camera attributes for the look: a slight blur of the far distance at [constant QUALITY_HIGH], none otherwise.

method.name: create_environment
method.description: Returns a new [Environment] with the look for [param quality] and [param atmosphere]. With [param clouds], the sky is a static cloud layer (lit on the sun side, darker below, denser toward the horizon) instead of the physical sky.

method.name: create_material
method.description: Returns a new [StandardMaterial3D] preset of [param kind].

method.name: get_default_quality
method.description: Returns the quality that suits [param rendering_method] ([code]"forward_plus"[/code], [code]"mobile"[/code] or [code]"gl_compatibility"[/code]).

method.name: add_blob_shadow
method.description: Adds a soft round shadow (a [Decal] named [code]BlobShadow[/code]) under [param node], at the bottom of its visual bounds (the feet of a centered sprite), and returns it. The grounding trick of pixel-art games: it anchors a sprite even where real shadows are faint.

method.name: apply_hd2d
method.description: Applies the "HD-2D" style (pixel-art sprites in a lit 3D diorama) to the scene under [param root] in one call: the look of [method apply_to_scene] at high quality with a little more glow; a [UZUTiltShift] after the look's post effect; every [Sprite3D] made a lit sprite with a one-texel outline ([method configure_lit_sprite]) and a blob shadow ([method add_blob_shadow]); one texel size for all sprites (the median) with nearest filtering, also as the project's default texture filter; and, when [param camera] is [code]true[/code], a telephoto camera looking down at 30 degrees that keeps the ground point the camera looked at and its framing. Returns what was done. Save the project settings too to keep the filter settings.

method.name: configure_lit_sprite
method.description: Makes [param sprite] a lit pixel-art sprite: the material of [method create_lit_sprite_material] as its [member GeometryInstance3D.material_override], shadow casting on, nearest filtering, alpha cut, and the sprite's own billboard off (the material faces the camera).

method.name: create_lit_sprite_material
method.description: Returns a material for pixel-art sprites that stand in the 3D world: a spatial shader that takes the scene's light, shadows and fog, faces the camera around the Y axis (also in shadow passes, so the shadow has the sprite's shape), cuts the alpha sharply, keeps texels crisp, optionally uses [param normal_map], and draws an outline [param outline_width] texels wide (up to 4) in [param outline_color].

method.name: get_shadow_filter_quality
method.description: Returns the soft shadow filter quality for the sun at [param quality] (a [enum RenderingServer.ShadowQuality] value): soft high at high quality, soft low (the engine default) otherwise. It is the project setting [member ProjectSettings.rendering/lights_and_shadows/directional_shadow/soft_shadow_filter_quality]; [method apply_to_scene] sets it in memory, so save the project settings too to keep it.

method.name: get_eye_height
method.description: Returns the camera height in meters for [param eye_level].

method.name: get_lens_fov
method.description: Returns the vertical field of view in degrees for [param lens].

constants.constant: Forward+ on a dedicated GPU: ambient occlusion, indirect light, screen-space reflections, soft shadows and far blur.
Forward+ on an integrated GPU, or Mobile: ambient occlusion and split shadows.
Compatibility renderer (Web): only features it supports.
Dry, clear air: the distance turns blue.
Humid air: the distance fades into a white haze, densest near the ground.
A low, warm sun near sunrise or sunset.
Weak, cool moonlight and a dark sky; add lamps with [method add_lamp].
Subsurface scattering in skin mode: soft, warm shadow edges.
Transparent water color with glossy reflections.
0.8 meters, a seated or child's view.
